title: LUMUI Document
description: Normative closed schema for a LUMUI 1.0 document. Per-kind component fields are selected by /specification/component-catalog.json.

id.description: Stable component identifier within the surface.

kind.description: Registered component kind that selects its semantic contract.

label.description: Primary human-readable name of the component.

description.description: Supporting explanation of the component or its current value.

enabled.description: Whether the person may currently operate the component.

visible.description: Whether the component participates in the current presentation.

priority.description: Semantic importance used during composition and disclosure.

sensitive.description: Sensitivity classification used by privacy and output policy.

live.description: Requested assistive announcement behavior for updates.

required.description: Whether a value or selection is required before completion.

readonly.description: Whether the value may be read but not changed.

value.description: Current scalar, structured or application-defined JSON value.

default_value.description: Value used when the person has not supplied one.

content.description: Textual or nested semantic content owned by the component.

alt.description: Text alternative that conveys the purpose of non-decorative media.

caption.description: Text associated with and explaining content or media.

title.description: Primary heading or title for the component.

message.description: Human-readable status, feedback or explanatory message.

unit.description: Unit associated with a numeric value or measurement.

values.description: Current ordered set of selected or series values.

indeterminate.description: Whether progress has no measurable current value.

columns.description: Definitions of table columns and their semantics.

rows.description: Table row values keyed or ordered according to columns.

nodes.description: Root nodes of a hierarchical component collection.

tabs.description: Peer components exposed as selectable tabs.

images.description: Ordered media resources in an image collection.

summary.description: Accessible textual summary of complex content.

table_fallback.description: Tabular semantic fallback for a data visualization.

action.description: ID of the declared action invoked by the component.

actions.description: Ordered IDs of declared actions offered by the component.

items.description: Ordered nested components contained by the component.

children.description: Ordered child components owned by the component.

options.description: Available choices or commands represented as option objects.

source.description: URI or typed media resource supplying component content.

external.description: Whether navigation intentionally leaves the current application context.

role.description: Semantic role used for structure or assistive presentation.

content_extent.description: Expected content volume used for initial composition.

variants.description: Alternative media resources for capability or density selection.

accept.description: Accepted media types or file patterns.

album.description: Album or collection associated with audio.

allow_custom.description: Whether a person may choose a value outside the supplied palette.

allow_empty.description: Whether no selection is a valid state.

allow_half.description: Whether half-step rating values are permitted.

allow_negative.description: Whether negative numeric values are permitted.

allow_open_end.description: Whether a date range may omit its end.

allow_reveal.description: Whether a viewer may offer temporary password revelation.

artist.description: Artist or creator associated with audio.

artwork.description: Artwork URI or media resource associated with playback.

attribution.description: Person or source to whom a quotation is attributed.

audio_description.description: URI reference of an audio-description track or resource.

auto_submit.description: Whether complete input invokes submission without a separate command.

autocomplete.description: Semantic autocomplete purpose understood by the host.

back_behavior.description: Requested logical behavior when navigating back from a page.

calendar.description: Calendar system used to interpret a date.

call_state.description: Current state of a telephone call.

capabilities.description: Capabilities required by a specialized renderer.

captions.description: Timed text tracks associated with media.

center.description: Geographic point initially centered by a map.

chart_type.description: Semantic visualization form requested for chart data.

cite.description: URI reference identifying the source of a quotation.

clear_action.description: Declared action that clears the current value.

collapsible.description: Whether a structural group may be collapsed.

confirmation.description: Confirmation level associated with an offered command.

contact.description: Structured contact associated with a dialer or communication control.

content_type.description: Semantic purpose or domain type of entered content.

copy_action.description: Declared action that copies represented content.

copy_policy.description: Policy describing how a selected file may be copied or retained.

correlation_id.description: Identifier used to correlate an error with diagnostics or support.

credit.description: Credit associated with media or figure content.

current_index.description: Zero-based index of the currently presented collection item.

current_location.description: Current geographic point when it is available and permitted.

current_step.description: Current route step index or structured maneuver.

data.description: Closed or application-defined structured data for the component.

debounce_ms.description: Delay before input changes may trigger an action.

decorative.description: Whether media carries no meaning and is omitted from accessibility output.

destination.description: Geographic destination used for routing or selection.

dirty.description: Whether form values differ from their committed state.

display_value.description: Human-readable representation of a numeric value.

distance_remaining.description: Remaining route distance in the declared unit or convention.

download.description: Whether a downloadable representation should be offered.

duration_ms.description: Total media, route or message duration in milliseconds.

editable.description: Whether a combobox permits text entry in addition to selection.

empty.description: Semantic component shown when a collection has no items.

estimated_count.description: Estimated total item count when the exact count is unavailable.

expanded_node_ids.description: IDs of tree nodes currently expanded.

expires_at.description: Date and time after which content is no longer current.

high.description: Upper threshold of a meter's noteworthy range.

icon.description: Registered symbol name or media resource associated with a command.

illustration.description: Decorative or semantic illustration for an empty state.

integrity.description: Integrity metadata used to verify specialized content.

intent.description: Purpose for which a file is selected.

keyboard.description: Preferred virtual keyboard or input layout hint.

language.description: Language identifier of text, code or media.

length.description: Expected number of entered characters or code positions.

low.description: Lower threshold of a meter's noteworthy range.

markers.description: Geographic markers displayed or listed by a map.

marks.description: Named values shown along a range control.

max_selected.description: Maximum permitted number of selected options.

meaning.description: Accessible meaning of a symbol or icon.

media_types.description: Accepted media categories for a system picker.

min_selected.description: Minimum required number of selected options.

number.description: Telephone number represented by a dialer.

optimum.description: Preferred value or range target of a meter.

pagination.description: Current page, page size and navigation references for a collection.

pattern.description: Validation pattern applied to entered text.

placeholder.description: Short input hint shown only while no value is present.

poster.description: Poster URI or media resource shown before video playback.

precision.description: Maximum or intended number of fractional digits.

preview.description: Whether tentative combobox selection may be previewed.

primary_action.description: Declared primary action associated with a page.

regions.description: Ordered semantic regions owned by a page.

rel.description: Relationship of a link to its current resource.

reorderable.description: Whether collection items may be reordered.

requires_capabilities.description: Host capabilities required before offering a picker or operation.

reset_action.description: Declared action that restores form defaults.

route.description: Structured route displayed by a map.

route_summary.description: Concise textual description of a route.

secondary_actions.description: Ordered declared secondary actions associated with a page.

selectable.description: Whether read-only content may be selected or copied.

selected.description: Selected state or selected component identifier.

selection_mode.description: Whether and how zero, one or many items may be selected.

series.description: Named data series represented by a chart.

session_id.description: Stable identifier of a media playback session.

severity.description: Semantic urgency or impact of feedback.

sortable.description: Whether table columns may invoke sorting.

source_link.description: URI or link object identifying the source of a figure.

spellcheck.description: Whether host spell checking is requested.

state_description.description: Human-readable explanation of the current state.

state_schema.description: Closed schema describing specialized graphic state.

submit_action.description: Declared action that submits a form or query.

suggestions.description: Suggested option values associated with current input.

target.description: Destination URI or storage target of a file operation.

text_role.description: Semantic role of text independent of visual styling.

timezone.description: Timezone used to interpret a date and time.

transcript.description: URI reference of a textual media transcript.

trigger.description: Component ID that opens or owns a menu.

type.description: Media, column, link or application-defined type identifier.

validation_mode.description: Event at which form validation is requested.

value_present.description: Whether a secret or one-time value currently exists without exposing it.

error.description: Current user-visible error state associated with the component.

fallback.description: Standard semantic component used when specialized rendering is unavailable.

metadata.description: Application metadata that does not alter standard component meaning.
